title: Claudius II Gothicus - Antoninianus - AEQVITAS AVG - IMP C CLAVDIVS AVG - Roman
description:
Roman Imperial Coin – Antoninianus of Claudius II Gothicus
 

 Roman Empire, AD 268–270


 Emperor: Claudius II Gothicus (Marcus Aurelius Claudius)
 

 Issuer: Roman Empire
 

 Reign: AD 268–270
 

 Denomination: Antoninianus
 

 Currency: Antoninianus, Reform of Caracalla (AD 215–301)
 

 Date: AD 268–270 (undated)


 Composition: Silver (billon)
 

 Weight: 3.28g
 

 Diameter: 19.7mm
 

 Shape: Irregular round
 

 Manufacture: Hammered
 


 Status: Demonetized


 Obverse:
 

 Radiate and draped bust of Claudius II Gothicus, facing right.
 

 Legend: IMP C CLAVDIVS AVG
 

 Translation: Imperator Caesar Claudius Augustus


 Reverse:
 

 Aequitas standing left, draped, holding scales in right hand and cornucopia in left; exergue blank or with officina mark.
 

 Legend: AEQVITAS AVG
 

 Translation: Equity of the Emperor


 References:
 

 RIC V.1, no. 197 (br)
 

 OCRE: ric.5.cg.197
 

 Numista catalogue no. 290286
